guideposts.label: Results at Alto Châteauneuf-Grasse (km 32.3)
guideposts.detail: 1. Bouwman, 3 pts 2. Uriarte, 2 pts 3. Hayter, 1 pt The winner of the KOM standings at the Giro 2022, Koen Bouwman (Jayco AlUla) is set to chase the polka dots again.

guideposts.label: The situation settles
guideposts.detail: At km 60, the peloton are 1'55'' behind Ethan Hayter (Soudal Quick-Step), Koen Bouwman (Jayco AlUla), Sinuhé Fernandez (Burgos Burpellet BH) and Diego Uriarte (Kern Pharma).

guideposts.label: A gap of 1'42'' at km 70
guideposts.detail: So far, the race scenario aligns with the predictions of Kaden Groves (Alpecin-Premier Tech): "It’s gonna be a hard stage, up and down, always sort of twisty roads. It’s a tough stage, especially the final, but I expect a small breakaway controlled by Visma to try and take the red jersey with Van Aert. I expect a bunch sprint but it’s a super hard final so you have to see how the legs are."

guideposts.label: The gap is decreasing
guideposts.detail: The peloton reach km 80 with a gap of 1'20''.
